cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes from a five-month live deployment (102 trading days) plus replay and backtest, with a short sample period not covering a full market cycle; replay and backtest are simulated results and cannot be directly extrapolated to future live performance; the risk-control effect under specific sector drawdown scenarios needs validation across more independent periods and market states.
cards.title: 多智能体LLM自主投资系统Steward：不变核心约束自我演化
cards.whyItMattersEn: It offers an engineering paradigm for LLM agents in irreversible, untrusted-web-content autonomous investing by embedding safety boundaries in the system's types and invariant core, and demonstrates performance differences between joint multi-role design and a single model in live replay.
cards.summary: 作者提出Steward多智能体LLM系统，将自我演化边界置于类型系统中，由九个角色专精代理联合决策，并配备七层共享记忆与季度反思学习。实盘五个月（102个交易日、1632次调用）中，系统将24.6%板块回撤控制为0.3%亏损；回放显示单模型在同一原始数据上交易更多且五日相对市场亏损1.35点，而联合设计无显著亏损。作者认为不变核心（订单算术、风险规则、纪律提示）是安全与绩效的关键，但实盘样本仅五个月，回放与回测结果需进一步验证。
cards.whyItMatters: 为LLM代理在不可逆、基于不可信网页内容的自主投资场景中，提供了一种将安全边界嵌入系统类型与不变核心的工程范式，并展示了联合多角色设计与单模型在实盘回放中的绩效差异。
cards.description: 该系统将自我演化边界编码于类型系统，通过九角色分工、七层记忆与可逆门控学习，在五个月实盘部署中将板块回撤24.6%控制为0.3%亏损，回放显示联合设计较单模型显著抗亏，且不变核心在随机入场策略下降低最大回撤。
cards.originalTitle: Governed Self-Evolution for Autonomous Investing: A Multi-Agent LLM System with an Invariant Core
keyPoints: 九角色代理分工：四名分析师输出类型化报告，组合经理设定目标仓位，受保护的风险经理审计。
七层共享记忆由代码从系统自身记录组装，为每项决策提供持仓背景、市场叙事、校准与历史决策。
代码夜间评分交易与预测并写入记忆，季度反射器提出提示学习，由确定性门控可逆应用并回放验证。
五个月实盘将24.6%板块回撤控制为0.3%亏损；回放中单模型五日相对市场亏1.35点，联合设计无显著亏损。
不变核心在2015-2026回测中使全部50种随机入场策略的最大回撤均降低。
cards.limitations: 证据来自五个月实盘（102个交易日）及回放与回测，样本期较短且未覆盖完整市场周期；回放与回测为模拟结果，不能直接外推为未来实盘表现；系统在特定板块回撤情境下的风控效果需更多独立期与市场状态验证。
cards.descriptionEn: The system encodes self-evolution boundaries in its type system and combines nine role-specialised agents, seven-layer memory, and reversible gated learning; in a five-month live deployment it contained a 24.6% sector drawdown to a 0.3% loss, replay showed the joint design avoided significant loss versus a single model, and the invariant core lowered maximum drawdown under random entry policies.
keyPointsEn: Nine role-specialised agents: four analysts emit typed reports, a Portfolio Manager sets target positions, and a protected Risk Manager audits.
A seven-layer shared memory assembled by code from the system's own record gives each decision position context, market narrative, calibration, and past decisions.
Code grades every trade and forecast nightly and writes grades into memory; a quarterly reflector proposes prompt learnings applied reversibly by a deterministic gate and verified by replay.

In five-month live deployment, a 24.6% sector drawdown was contained to a 0.3% loss; in replay, a single model lost 1.35 points against the market over five days while the joint design showed no significant loss.
The invariant core lowered maximum drawdown under all 50 random entry policies in a 2015-2026 backtest.
cards.titleEn: Multi-Agent LLM System Steward for Autonomous Investing with Invariant Core Constraints on Self-Evolution
cards.summaryEn: The authors present Steward, a multi-agent LLM system that draws the boundary of self-evolution in its type system, with nine role-specialised agents deciding jointly, a seven-layer shared memory, and quarterly reflector learning. In a five-month live deployment (102 trading days, 1,632 LLM calls), the system contained a 24.6% sector drawdown to a 0.3% loss; replay showed a single model given the same raw data traded more and lost 1.35 points against the market over five days where the joint design showed no significant loss. The authors argue the invariant core (order arithmetic, risk rules, discipline prompts) is key to safety and performance, but the live sample is only five months and replay/backtest results require further validation.

cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is bounded: all results come from the author-designed MetaInvest-Bench simulator, with financial streams serving only as a risk-sensitive testbed, not real-market validation. Calibration is an update-level replay statistic; it guarantees neither overall utility improvement, nor absence of simulated canary-stage harm, nor sequence-level error control. The 3.4% and 4.8% false-promotion rates are empirical observations on this specific benchmark and should not be generalized as universal guarantees.
cards.title: 保守式元智能体搜索：非平稳场景下的架构自适应
cards.whyItMattersEn: It offers a conservative replacement and risk-constrained engineering framework for deploying automated agent architectures in non-stationary environments, and stresses that meta-level generalization cannot be certified by backtests alone, requiring dedicated benchmarks and negative controls.
cards.summary: 论文将元智能体架构搜索形式化为带切换成本和硬风险约束的序贯现任替换问题，提出CMAS方法，通过配对影子回放和干预式组件归因评估候选架构。实验基于作者设计的MetaInvest-Bench模拟器，在96条流上报告了替代动态预言机遗憾和留出效用两项指标。作者明确声称不主张任何超额收益（alpha），且校准仅针对更新级回放统计量，不保证全效用提升或序列级误差控制。
cards.whyItMatters: 为自动化智能体架构在非平稳环境中的部署提供了保守替换与风险约束的工程框架，并强调元层面泛化无法由回测认证，需专用基准与负控制检验。
cards.description: 该研究将元智能体架构搜索建模为带切换代价与硬风险约束的序贯替换问题，提出保守式元智能体搜索（CMAS）方法，并发布MetaInvest-Bench基准用于评估元层面泛化能力。其价值在于提供了一套在非平稳、延迟反馈环境下可审计、可回滚的架构部署流程，并量化了误晋升率等风险指标。
cards.originalTitle: Conservative Meta-Agent Search: Architecture Adaptation under Non-Stationarity
keyPoints: CMAS将架构搜索建模为序贯替换，要求候选架构在方差惩罚后的同时评分超过预设边际，并经模拟金丝雀阶段和预定义回滚才晋升。
在96条流上，CMAS将归一化平均替代动态预言机遗憾从0.116降至0.104，留出效用从0.44升至0.48，优于最强自适应基线。
当额外工作者无价值时，CMAS可收缩至近单智能体团队；其部署推理成本约低6%，但含搜索的总token成本为对比方法中最高。
cards.limitations: 证据边界明确：全部结果基于作者设计的MetaInvest-Bench模拟器，金融流仅作为风险敏感测试床，不构成真实市场验证；校准为更新级回放统计量，不保证整体效用提升、不保证模拟金丝雀阶段无损害、也不提供序列级误差控制；误晋升率3.4%和4.8%仅为特定基准上的经验观测，不可外推为通用保证。
cards.descriptionEn: This study formalizes meta-agent architecture search as sequential incumbent replacement with switching costs and hard risk constraints, introduces Conservative Meta-Agent Search (CMAS), and releases MetaInvest-Bench, a regime-switching simulator for evaluating meta-level generalization. Its value lies in an auditable, rollback-capable deployment procedure for non-stationary, delayed-feedback settings, with quantified risk metrics such as false-promotion rate.
keyPointsEn: CMAS models architecture search as sequential replacement: a candidate must exceed a pre-specified margin on a variance-penalized simultaneous score, then pass a simulated canary stage with pre-specified rollback before promotion.
Across 96 streams, CMAS reduces normalized mean surrogate dynamic-oracle regret from 0.116 to 0.104 and raises held-out utility from 0.44 to 0.48 over the strongest adaptive baseline.
When extra workers add no value, CMAS contracts to near-single-agent teams; its deployment inference cost is ~6% lower, though search-inclusive token cost is the highest among compared methods.
cards.titleEn: Conservative Meta-Agent Search: Architecture Adaptation under Non-Stationarity
cards.summaryEn: The paper formulates meta-agent architecture search as sequential incumbent replacement with switching costs and hard risk constraints, and proposes CMAS, which evaluates candidates via paired shadow replay with interventional component credit. Experiments on the author-designed MetaInvest-Bench simulator over 96 streams report surrogate dynamic-oracle regret and held-out utility. The authors explicitly claim no alpha, and the calibration concerns only an update-level replay statistic on that benchmark, guaranteeing neither full-utility improvement nor sequence-level error control.

cards.limitationsEn: The study is validated only at 121M and 374M pretraining scales and LLaMA-7B pruning settings, without covering larger models or other architectures; certified bounds are limited to a specified finite candidate set; the magnitude of improvement and generalizability require further testing.
cards.title: 残差感知谱容量优化Transformer异构资源分配
cards.whyItMattersEn: This method provides a training-free heuristic for predicting Transformer performance to guide architecture design when training costs are limited, and demonstrates potential performance gains in pretraining and pruning scenarios.
cards.summary: Neural Spectral Capacity (NSC) 是一种根据架构规格预测相对训练性能的启发式方法，但独立评分投影且对兼容重排给出相同分数。本文提出ResNSC，利用规格推导的统计参考确定每个投影容量计算中的输入和残差状态统计，并扩展NSC-DP分配器以纳入残差历史。实验表明，在121M和374M预训练规模下，所选架构在可比参数预算下困惑度低于均匀、可变宽度和锥形分配；在LLaMA-7B剪枝中，八任务平均准确率提升3.28-5.46个百分点。
cards.whyItMatters: 该方法为Transformer架构设计提供了一种无需训练即可预测性能的启发式工具，有助于在训练成本受限时指导资源分配，并在预训练和剪枝场景中展示了性能提升潜力。
cards.description: 提出残差感知神经谱容量（ResNSC），通过引入残差上下文改进Transformer架构性能预测，并增强分配器以联合分配残差与FFN宽度，在预训练和剪枝任务中验证有效性。
cards.originalTitle: Neural Spectral Capacity with Residual Context for Heterogeneous Resource Allocation within Transformers
keyPoints: ResNSC引入残差更新统计参考，改进了NSC对投影独立评分的问题。
ResNSC-DP联合分配残差和FFN宽度，并给出有限候选集内最优分数的认证边界。
在预训练和剪枝设置中，ResNSC-DP优于基线分配策略，且配对反转实验揭示了位置独立评分忽略的性能差异。
cards.limitations: 研究仅在121M和374M预训练规模及LLaMA-7B剪枝设置中验证，未涉及更大规模模型或其他架构；认证边界限于指定有限候选集；性能提升幅度和泛化性需进一步测试。
cards.descriptionEn: Introduces Residual-Aware Neural Spectral Capacity (ResNSC), which improves Transformer performance prediction by incorporating residual context and enhances the allocator to jointly allocate residual and feed-forward widths, validated in pretraining and pruning tasks.
keyPointsEn: ResNSC introduces a statistical reference for residual updates, addressing NSC's independent scoring of projections.
ResNSC-DP jointly allocates residual and feed-forward widths and provides certified bounds on the best score within a finite candidate set.
ResNSC-DP outperforms baseline allocation strategies in pretraining and pruning, and paired reversal experiments reveal performance differences hidden by position-independent scoring.
cards.titleEn: Residual-Aware Neural Spectral Capacity for Heterogeneous Resource Allocation in Transformers
cards.summaryEn: Neural Spectral Capacity (NSC) is a heuristic for predicting relative trained performance from architectural specifications, but it scores projections independently and assigns identical scores to compatible reorderings. This work proposes ResNSC, which uses a specification-derived statistical reference for accumulated residual updates to determine input and residual-state statistics in each projection's capacity calculation, and augments the NSC-DP allocator with residual history. Experiments show that at 121M and 374M pretraining scales, selected architectures achieve lower perplexity than uniform, variable-width, and tapered allocations at comparable parameter budgets, and in LLaMA-7B pruning, ResNSC-DP improves eight-task average accuracy by 3.28–5.46 percentage points.

cards.limitationsEn: The conclusions are based on controlled empirical studies and the nuPlan benchmark, without real-road deployment. EGRL relies on logged expert data, and its generalizability and effectiveness on other datasets require further validation.
cards.title: 简化训练策略在自动驾驶中优于复杂模型
cards.whyItMattersEn: This work offers an alternative path for autonomous driving planning that does not rely on large models or complex reward engineering. It suggests that training strategy design may be more cost-effective than model scaling, helping lower deployment barriers and improve inference efficiency.
cards.summary: 自动驾驶闭环规划面临分布偏移和复合误差等挑战。作者提出Expert-Guided RL（EGRL）训练策略，利用专家数据导出的轨迹距离奖励，以RL作为优化工具。实验表明训练策略对性能贡献显著，基于EGRL的轻量MLP模型DriveMLP在nuPlan基准上取得86.51分，超越此前最佳IL规划器。
cards.whyItMatters: 该工作为自动驾驶规划提供了一条不依赖大规模模型和复杂奖励工程的替代路径，表明训练策略设计可能比模型规模更具性价比，有助于降低部署门槛并提升推理效率。
cards.description: 研究发现，在自动驾驶闭环规划中，训练策略而非模型复杂度是性能提升的主要来源。作者提出EGRL策略和轻量MLP模型DriveMLP，在nuPlan基准上超越此前最佳IL规划器，且推理速度更快。
cards.originalTitle: DriveMLP: When Training Strategy Outperforms Model Complexity in Autonomous Driving
keyPoints: EGRL策略使用专家数据导出的轨迹距离奖励，以强化学习作为优化工具。
轻量MLP模型DriveMLP在nuPlan Val14 Reactive基准取得86.51分，较此前最佳IL规划器提升3.2分。
DriveMLP推理速度超过此前最佳IL规划器15倍。
cards.limitations: 结论基于受控实证研究和nuPlan基准测试，未涉及真实道路部署；EGRL依赖日志专家数据，其泛化性和在其他数据集上的有效性仍需进一步验证。
cards.descriptionEn: The study finds that in closed-loop autonomous driving planning, training strategy rather than model complexity accounts for substantial performance gains. The authors propose the EGRL strategy and a lightweight MLP model DriveMLP, which outperforms the previous best IL planner on the nuPlan benchmark with faster inference.
keyPointsEn: EGRL uses a trajectory-distance reward derived from expert data and treats RL purely as an optimization tool.
The lightweight MLP model DriveMLP scores 86.51 on the nuPlan Val14 Reactive benchmark, a +3.2 point improvement over the previous best IL planner.
DriveMLP achieves over 15x faster inference than the previous best IL planner.
cards.titleEn: Training Strategy Outperforms Model Complexity in Autonomous Driving
cards.summaryEn: Closed-loop planning in autonomous driving faces challenges such as distribution shift and compounding errors. The authors propose Expert-Guided RL (EGRL), which uses a trajectory-distance reward derived from expert data and RL purely as an optimization tool. Experiments show training procedure contributes significantly to performance, and the lightweight MLP model DriveMLP trained with EGRL achieves 86.51 on the nuPlan benchmark, surpassing the previous best IL planner.

cards.limitationsEn: Evidence comes from a single-exchange high-frequency dataset and a specific sample of institutional proprietary trading, so external validity is limited; hypothetical flow-following Sharpe ratios are not equivalent to replicable live strategy returns; regression results are statistical associations, not direct causal proof linking forecasting ability or liquidity provision to P&L; the currency unit is not specified in the abstract, limiting cross-market comparison.
cards.title: 机构交易者日内预测能力与做市收益的关联
cards.whyItMattersEn: If forecasting ability and passive execution are positively associated with intraday P&L, performance evaluation and execution design should consider both information advantages and liquidity-provision roles, not just trade prices or aggregate returns.
cards.summary: 研究使用某交易所高频数据考察机构交易者自营日内盈利与预测能力、流动性提供的关系。作者发现预测能力具有持续性，并报告基于技能型交易者执行流的假想跟随策略在不同频率下年化夏普比率为16至63。作者进一步将买卖执行配对为持仓，发现预测能力代理指标每提高一个标准差，单笔配对持仓盈亏高1.02至1.19货币单位，且被动执行次数越多盈亏越高。
cards.whyItMatters: 若预测能力与被动执行确实与日内盈亏同向关联，则评估交易绩效和设计执行策略时需同时关注信息优势与流动性提供角色，而非只看成交价格或总收益。
cards.description: 该研究利用某交易所高频数据，将机构自营交易的买卖执行配对为持仓，并把已实现盈亏与持有期匹配的预测代理指标及流动性提供角色联系起来，说明预测能力与被动执行如何共同对应更高盈亏。其价值在于为日内交易盈利来源提供可检验的分解框架，而非仅报告总体收益。
cards.originalTitle: Intraday Forecasting Ability and Liquidity Provision of Institutional Traders
keyPoints: 预测能力在部分机构交易者中表现出持续性，基于其执行流的假想跟随策略在不同交易频率下年化夏普比率为16至63。
预测能力代理指标每提高一个标准差，匹配持仓的已实现盈亏高1.02至1.19货币单位。
同一匹配持仓内，一次被动执行较零次盈亏高1.28至1.31货币单位，两次较一次再高3.79至3.82货币单位。
cards.limitations: 证据来自单一交易所的高频数据集与特定机构自营交易样本，结论外推需谨慎；假想跟随策略的夏普比率不等同于可实盘复制的策略收益；回归结果为统计关联，不能直接证明预测能力或流动性提供与盈亏之间的因果关系；货币单位未在摘要中说明，跨市场比较受限。
cards.descriptionEn: Using high-frequency exchange data, the study matches institutional proprietary buy and sell executions into positions and links realized P&L to horizon-matched forecasting proxies and each execution's liquidity role. Its value lies in a testable decomposition of intraday trading profitability rather than reporting aggregate returns alone.
keyPointsEn: Forecasting ability is persistent among some institutional traders; hypothetical flow-following strategies based on their execution flows yield annualized Sharpe ratios of 16 to 63 across trading frequencies.
A one-standard-deviation increase in the forecasting-ability proxy is associated with 1.02–1.19 currency units higher realized P&L per matched position.
Within a matched position, one passive execution is associated with 1.28–1.31 currency units higher P&L than none, and two are 3.79–3.82 higher than one.
cards.titleEn: Forecasting Ability, Liquidity Provision, and Intraday P&L of Institutional Traders
cards.summaryEn: The study uses high-frequency data from a stock exchange to examine how forecasting ability and liquidity provision relate to institutional traders' proprietary intraday profitability. The authors find persistent forecasting ability and report that hypothetical flow-following strategies based on skillful traders' execution flows yield annualized Sharpe ratios of 16 to 63 across trading frequencies. Matching buy and sell executions into positions, they find that a one-standard-deviation increase in the forecasting proxy is associated with 1.02–1.19 currency units higher P&L per matched position, and P&L rises with the number of passive executions.

cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is limited to experiments on three text-interaction benchmarks: TextWorld, ALFWorld, and Robotouille; it does not cover real-world or visual environments. Results depend on the quality of the offline fine-tuned language–symbol interface and on candidate hypothesis generation, and the effectiveness of positive and negative memory is affected by the hypothesis space and parsing errors. The efficiency and cost conclusions are author-reported and require independent replication, and nothing here constitutes investment advice.
cards.title: MemPlan：面向部分可观测文本环境的记忆条件PDDL规划
cards.whyItMattersEn: If the combination of memory-conditioned PDDL and a lightweight language interface generalizes, long-horizon text interaction tasks could retain symbolic verifiability while reducing reliance on online LLM planning and token cost, offering a methodological reference for low-cost, auditable agent planning pipelines.
cards.summary: 论文针对大语言模型作为长程规划器成本高且易产生幻觉或无效动作的问题，提出在固定PDDL领域的前提下，每步从解析观测、候选假设与交互记忆中重建PDDL问题。作者称在TextWorld、ALFWorld和Robotouille上，MemPlan相较纯语言与PDDL感知基线提升了任务完成率与步效率，并显著降低在线token开销；这些为作者报告的结果判断，尚需独立复现。
cards.whyItMatters: 若记忆条件PDDL与轻量语言接口的组合可推广，则长程文本交互任务可在保持符号可验证性的同时减少对大模型在线规划的依赖与token成本，对构建低成本、可审计的智能体规划链路具有方法参考意义。
cards.description: 该工作提出MemPlan框架，将大语言模型从长程规划主体转为语言与符号规划之间的受限接口，并用正负记忆重建每步PDDL问题。其新意在于以记忆引导候选假设排序、以失败记录排除已证伪选项；对降低在线token开销、提升文本环境任务完成率有参考价值。
cards.originalTitle: MemPlan: Memory-Conditioned PDDL Planning for Partially Observable Text Environments
keyPoints: MemPlan固定PDDL领域，并在每一步由解析观测、候选假设和交互记忆重建PDDL问题，形成记忆条件的规划循环。
正向图记忆按相关性为缺失对象、位置或条件的候选假设计算动作代价，负向记忆把被反驳的假设编译为排除约束。
经离线监督微调的统一模式条件语言—符号接口，负责观测到事实的解析和符号动作到命令的落地，并被复用于TextWorld多种任务类型。
cards.limitations: 证据范围限于TextWorld、ALFWorld和Robotouille三类文本交互基准上的实验，未涉及真实世界或视觉环境；结果依赖离线监督微调的语言—符号接口质量与候选假设生成，正负记忆的有效性受假设空间与解析错误影响；文中的效率与成本结论为作者报告，需独立复现验证，且不构成任何投资建议。
cards.descriptionEn: This work proposes MemPlan, which recasts large language models from long-horizon planners into constrained interfaces between language and symbolic planning, reconstructing the PDDL problem at each step from positive and negative memory. Its novelty lies in memory-guided ranking of candidate hypotheses and exclusion constraints from refuted assumptions; it is relevant for reducing online token cost and improving task completion in text environments.
keyPointsEn: MemPlan fixes the PDDL domain and rebuilds the PDDL problem each step from parsed observations, candidate hypotheses, and interaction memory, forming a memory-conditioned planning loop.

Positive graph memory assigns relevance-based action costs to candidate hypotheses for missing objects, locations, or conditions, while negative memory compiles refuted assumptions into exclusion constraints.

A unified schema-conditioned language–symbol interface, trained offline with supervised fine-tuning, handles observation-to-fact parsing and symbolic-action-to-command grounding, and is reused across TextWorld task types.
cards.titleEn: MemPlan: Memory-Conditioned PDDL Planning for Partially Observable Text Environments
cards.summaryEn: Addressing the high cost and hallucination-prone nature of LLM long-horizon planners, the paper proposes keeping the PDDL domain fixed while reconstructing the PDDL problem each step from parsed observations, candidate hypotheses, and interaction memory. The authors report that on TextWorld, ALFWorld, and Robotouille, MemPlan improves task completion and step efficiency over language-only and PDDL-aware baselines while substantially reducing online token cost; these are the authors' reported results and require independent replication.

cards.limitationsEn: Conclusions are based on 12 problem families and 12 models, not covering all NP-complete problems or architectures; hardened statements are adversarially generated with human verification but sample size and verification scope are limited; pass@1 reflects single-generation success and may be affected by sampling strategy; no direct evidence on internal model mechanisms is provided.
cards.title: 配对P与NP完全问题的对抗改写基准：模型在NPC侧准确率显著下降
cards.whyItMattersEn: The benchmark offers a way to control surface phrasing and separate complexity-class reasoning from memorization, enabling finer-grained evaluation of LLMs' genuine algorithmic reasoning rather than reliance on textbook cues.
cards.summary: 作者提出P2NPCBench，通过对抗改写生成2,114条经人工验证的硬化陈述，使NP完全问题与P孪生问题在表面措辞上不可区分。评估12个模型发现所有模型在NPC侧通过率低于P侧（35.4% vs 63.8%），多数模型对表现出此模式，且错误主要来自程序错误而非超时。作者认为类间差距部分源于对教科书措辞的熟悉度，硬化后差距从24.8点缩至14.6点。
cards.whyItMatters: 该基准提供了一种控制表面措辞、区分复杂度类别推理与记忆的方法，有助于更细粒度地评估LLM在算法问题上的真实推理能力，而非仅依赖教科书式线索。
cards.description: 该研究构建P2NPCBench基准，将12类NP完全问题与其多项式时间孪生问题以相同表面措辞配对，并用AgentGAN对抗多智能体框架改写题干以去除教科书线索。结果显示12个模型在NPC问题上通过率仅35.4%，远低于P孪生问题的63.8%，且95.1%的模型对在NPC侧失败更多；时间限制放宽十倍仅将NPC准确率从28.5%提升至31.9%，说明失败源于程序错误而非速度。
cards.originalTitle: Did the Problem Actually Get Harder? Testing LLMs on Paired P and NP-Complete Problems Hardened by Adversarial Multi-Agent Rewriting
keyPoints: P2NPCBench包含12个问题家族，每个NPC问题与同表面的P孪生问题配对，共2,114条硬化陈述并附人工验证参考解。
12个模型在NPC陈述上的pass@1为35.4%，在P孪生上为63.8%，95.1%的模型对在NPC侧失败率更高。
十倍时间限制仅将NPC准确率从28.5%提至31.9%，表明失败源于错误或崩溃程序而非运行慢。
cards.limitations: 结论基于12个问题家族和12个模型的评估，未覆盖所有NP完全问题或模型架构；硬化陈述由对抗生成并人工验证，但样本规模与验证范围有限；pass@1指标反映单次生成成功率，可能受采样策略影响；未涉及模型内部机制的直接证据。
cards.descriptionEn: The study builds P2NPCBench, pairing 12 NP-complete problem families with polynomial-time twins under identical surface wording, and uses the AgentGAN adversarial multi-agent framework to rewrite statements and remove textbook cues. Across 12 models, pass@1 on NPC problems is only 35.4% versus 63.8% on P twins, and 95.1% of model pairs fail more on the NPC side; a tenfold time limit raises NPC accuracy only from 28.5% to 31.9%, indicating failures stem from incorrect programs
keyPointsEn: P2NPCBench contains 12 problem families, each pairing an NPC problem with a surface-identical P twin, totaling 2,114 hardened statements with human-verified reference solutions.
Across 12 models, pass@1 is 35.4% on NPC statements versus 63.8% on P twins, and 95.1% of model pairs fail more often on the NPC side.
A tenfold time limit raises NPC accuracy only from 28.5% to 31.9%, showing failures stem from wrong or crashing programs rather than slow runtime.
cards.titleEn: Paired P and NP-Complete Problems with Adversarial Rewriting: Models Show Markedly Lower Accuracy on NPC Side
cards.summaryEn: The authors introduce P2NPCBench, generating 2,114 human-verified hardened statements that make NP-complete problems surface-indistinguishable from their P twins via adversarial rewriting. Evaluating 12 models, all score lower on NPC statements than on P twins (35.4% vs 63.8%), most model pairs show this pattern, and errors mainly arise from incorrect programs rather than timeouts. The authors suggest part of the class gap reflects familiarity with textbook phrasing, as hardening narrows the gap from 24.8 to 14.6 points.

cards.limitationsEn: The source is a Hugging Face release introduction and provides no model compatibility scope, hardware requirements, performance benchmarks, privacy or security audits, or comparisons with similar tools. The specific boundaries of its 'free and open source' and offline capabilities should be verified against official documentation and hands-on testing, and it should not be used to infer actual experience or investment value.
cards.title: Llama 推出 Mac 本地菜单栏 AI 运行工具
cards.whyItMattersEn: The tool integrates local model deployment and a chat interface into the desktop menu bar, lowering the barrier to using local AI on a Mac; it is relevant to users interested in keeping data on-device, offline availability, and open API access.
cards.summary: Hugging Face 发布 Llama，一个在 Mac 菜单栏中本地运行 AI 模型的工具。据来源介绍，它可按设备匹配模型、一键下载并离线对话，数据留在本机，兼容 OpenAI API 的应用也能连接。该工具免费开源，由 llama.cpp 团队推出。
cards.whyItMatters: 该工具将本地模型部署与聊天界面整合到桌面菜单栏，降低了在 Mac 上使用本地 AI 的操作门槛；对关注数据留在本机、离线可用和开放接口接入的用户具有参考价值。
cards.description: Hugging Face 发布了名为 Llama 的新工具，可在 Mac 上从菜单栏直接本地运行 AI 模型，支持按机型匹配模型、一键下载、离线对话，并允许兼容 OpenAI API 的应用接入。其价值在于把本地推理流程简化为桌面级操作，且对话数据保留在本机。
cards.originalTitle: Llama: Local AI on Your Mac
keyPoints: 工具以 Mac 菜单栏为入口，主打本地运行与离线使用
提供按 Mac 配置查找模型、一键下载和直接对话的流程
对话保留在用户电脑上，支持兼容 OpenAI API 的应用接入

cards.descriptionEn: Hugging Face released Llama, a tool that runs AI models locally on a Mac directly from the menu bar, with device-matched model discovery, one-click downloads, offline chat, and support for apps compatible with the OpenAI API. Its value lies in simplifying local inference into a desktop workflow while keeping conversations on the machine.
keyPointsEn: The tool uses the Mac menu bar as its entry point and focuses on local, offline use
It offers a workflow to find models matching the Mac, download them in one click, and start chatting
Conversations stay on the user's computer, and apps compatible with the OpenAI API can connect
cards.titleEn: Llama Launches a Menu-Bar Tool for Running AI Locally on Mac
cards.summaryEn: Hugging Face released Llama, a tool for running AI models locally on a Mac from the menu bar. According to the source, it matches models to the device, supports one-click downloads and offline chat, keeps conversations on the computer, and lets apps compatible with the OpenAI API connect. It is free and open source, from the makers of llama.cpp.

cards.limitationsEn: The conclusions are based on equilibrium model simulations calibrated to 2025 German data, not on actual deployment observations; the study focuses on wholesale price feedback and does not cover real-world factors such as distribution network congestion pricing, local network constraints, or user behavior heterogeneity that may affect results; the author also notes that new local peaks remain possible in grids where battery deployment runs ahead of the national average. Therefore, extrapolation of the results should be made cautiously in light of specific grid conditions.
cards.title: 价格反馈缺失导致家庭电池同步充电的本地电网峰值被高估
cards.whyItMattersEn: This finding implies that ignoring price feedback may lead policymakers and grid planners to overestimate the peak stress that synchronized home battery charging places on local distribution grids, thereby affecting judgments on grid reinforcement needs, demand response policies, and battery incentives. The conclusion is robust across multiple scenarios and parameter settings, offering an important correction for more accurately assessing the impact of distributed storage on distribution grids.
cards.summary: 既有研究普遍发现，家庭电池依据实时电价同步充电会在本地配电网中制造新的负荷峰值，原因是所有资产对同一价格信号做出同步响应。本文指出，这些研究大多将批发电价视为外生，忽略了电池充电行为本身会推高电价、进而抑制充电激励的反馈机制。作者通过模拟发现，在考虑价格内生性后，同步充电导致的本地电网峰值远低于外生价格假设下的结果。
cards.whyItMatters: 该发现提示，若忽略价格反馈，政策制定者和电网规划者可能高估家庭电池同步充电对本地配电网的峰值压力，从而影响对电网加固需求、需求响应政策和电池激励措施的判断。研究结论在多种情景和参数设定下保持稳健，为更准确地评估分布式储能对配电网的影响提供了重要修正。
cards.description: 该研究指出，既有文献在评估实时电价下家庭电池对本地配电网峰值的影响时，通常将批发电价视为外生不变，忽略了电池充电行为本身会推高电价并抑制同步充电的反馈机制。作者通过构建校准至2025年德国数据的均衡批发电价模型进行模拟，发现考虑价格内生性后，同步充电造成的本地电网峰值大幅降低，表明此前研究可能显著高估了相关风险。
cards.originalTitle: The missing price feedback: Why studies overstate local grid peaks from synchronized home batteries under real-time pricing
keyPoints: 在外生价格假设下，同步充电使本地电网的同时进口峰值较无电池基准高出83%。
在价格内生（考虑反馈）条件下，同一电池车队使该峰值较无电池基准低6%。
将价格视为内生可将高电池渗透率下的同时峰值降低近一半。
cards.limitations: 结论基于校准至德国2025年数据的均衡模型模拟，而非实际部署观测；研究聚焦于批发电价反馈，未涵盖配电网拥堵定价、本地网络约束或用户行为异质性等可能影响结果的现实因素；作者也指出，在电池部署领先于全国平均水平的电网中，新的本地峰值仍可能出现。因此，结果的外推需结合具体电网条件谨慎判断。
cards.descriptionEn: This study argues that existing literature assessing the impact of home batteries on local distribution grid peaks under real-time pricing typically treats wholesale prices as exogenous, ignoring the feedback that battery charging itself raises prices and dampens synchronized charging. Using a simulation with an equilibrium wholesale price model calibrated to 2025 German data, the author finds that accounting for price endogeneity substantially reduces the estimated local gri
keyPointsEn: With exogenous prices, synchronous charging pushes the coincident import peak of the local grid to 83% above its no-battery level.
With endogenous prices (including feedback), the same battery fleet leaves the peak 6% below the no-battery benchmark.
Treating prices as endogenous reduces the coincident peak at high battery penetration nearly by half.
cards.titleEn: Missing Price Feedback Leads to Overestimation of Local Grid Peaks from Synchronized Home Battery Charging
cards.summaryEn: Existing studies consistently find that home batteries optimized against real-time prices create new load peaks in local distribution grids because all assets respond synchronously to the same price signal. This paper points out that most of these studies treat wholesale prices as exogenous, overlooking the feedback that charging raises wholesale prices and dampens the incentive to charge. Simulations show that with endogenous prices, the coincident local grid peak caused by synchronized charging is much lower than under exogenous-price assumptions.

cards.limitationsEn: Evidence is based on simulation studies covering forward-start, barrier, and realized-variance claims; results are limited to the specified prior-predictive model and are not validated on real market data or across other rough volatility models or broader contract types.
cards.title: 深度粗糙波动率校准：后验不确定性量化与信息论可解释性
cards.whyItMattersEn: Neural point calibration cannot capture residual uncertainty after observing an IV surface; this framework explicitly propagates posterior uncertainty to exotic option prices and uses information-theoretic attribution to enhance explainability of calibration and pricing, supporting uncertainty-aware risk assessment within the specified model.
cards.summary: 事实：作者开发了针对 rough Heston 校准的模拟推断框架，利用神经比率估计获得后验样本，并经异方差代理定价器传播，形成后验预测分布和价格区间；还提出 Hellinger-SHAP 方法，用局部背景 Kernel SHAP 归因后验信息泛函。模拟研究表明，后验预测区间在前向启动、障碍和已实现方差索赔上具有校准或保守覆盖，而点代入价格在部分合约情形可能明显不可靠。作者观点：该 UQ 与 XAI 分析为不确定性感知的神经校准及下游奇异期权定价提供了透明框架，但结论限于所指定的先验预测模型。
cards.whyItMatters: 神经点校准无法刻画观察到 IV 曲面后的残余不确定性；该框架将后验不确定性显式传播至奇异期权价格，并用信息论归因增强校准与定价过程的可解释性，有助于在指定模型内进行不确定性感知的风险评估。
cards.description: 该研究提出基于模拟推断的 rough Heston 模型校准框架，学习以隐含波动率曲面为条件的参数后验分布，并将后验不确定性传播至异方差神经代理定价器，产生不确定性感知的价格区间；同时引入 Hellinger-SHAP 解释后验信息增益。其新意在于将后验推断与可解释性结合，为奇异期权定价提供透明的风险量化路径。
cards.originalTitle: Uncertainty and Explainability in Deep Rough Volatility: A Neural Information-Theoretic Posterior Approach
keyPoints: 提出基于模拟推断的 rHeston 校准框架，学习以 IV 曲面为条件的参数后验分布。
将后验样本经异方差神经代理定价器传播，得到结合参数与代理不确定性的后验预测价格区间。
提出 Hellinger-SHAP，对后验信息泛函进行局部背景 Kernel SHAP 归因，识别与各参数后验信息增益相关的期限—行权价区域。
cards.limitations: 证据基于模拟研究，覆盖前向启动、障碍和已实现方差索赔；结果限于所指定的先验预测模型，未在真实市场数据上验证，也未涵盖其他粗糙波动率模型或更广泛的合约类型。
cards.descriptionEn: This study proposes a simulation-based inference framework for rough Heston calibration that learns the posterior distribution of parameters conditional on an implied-volatility surface and propagates posterior uncertainty through heteroscedastic neural surrogate pricers to produce uncertainty-aware price intervals; it also introduces Hellinger-SHAP to explain posterior information gain. Its novelty lies in combining posterior inference with explainability to provide a transp
keyPointsEn: Proposes a simulation-based inference framework for rHeston calibration that learns the posterior distribution of parameters conditional on an IV surface.
Propagates posterior samples through heteroscedastic neural surrogate pricers to obtain posterior-predictive price intervals combining parameter and surrogate uncertainty.

Introduces Hellinger-SHAP, applying local-background Kernel SHAP to a posterior-information functional to identify maturity–moneyness regions associated with posterior information gain for each parameter.
cards.titleEn: Deep Rough Volatility Calibration: Posterior Uncertainty Quantification and Information-Theoretic Explainability
cards.summaryEn: Fact: The authors develop a simulation-based inference framework for rough Heston calibration, use neural ratio estimation to obtain posterior samples, propagate them through heteroscedastic surrogate pricers to form posterior-predictive distributions and price intervals, and propose Hellinger-SHAP, which applies local-background Kernel SHAP to a posterior-information functional. Simulation studies show that posterior-predictive intervals provide calibrated or conservative coverage for forward-start, barrier, and realized-variance claims, while point plug-in prices can be materially unreliable in selected contract regimes. Author view: The UQ and XAI analyses provide a transparent framework for uncertainty-aware neural calibration and downstream exotic pricing, but conclusions are limited to the specified prior-predictive model.
